title: Beyond-Birthday Security for Single-Permutation 4-TEM
summary: The conjectured result is security beyond the birthday bound for single-permutation 4-TEM; proving or refuting it remains open.

formal_statement.body: Prove or refute beyond-birthday-bound security of 4-TEM when $\pi_1=\pi_2=\pi_3=\pi_4$.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptography, specifically security of a tweakable Even-Mansour block-cipher construction.
parameters: The four round permutations, whose identity defines the single-permutation variant
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether the single-permutation 4-TEM achieves security beyond the birthday bound by proving or refuting the conjecture.

citations.label: Minimizing the Two-Round Tweakable Even-Mansour Cipher

progress.summary: The source's conclusion explicitly presents this as a conjecture for single-permutation 4-TEM and states that its security proof is currently unknown.
citation_labels: Avijit Dutta et al., Minimizing the Two-Round Tweakable Even-Mansour Cipher
